gnote: Seven harnesses from one rule source, the clearest instance of portability here, and it writes an AGENTS.md. Approval gates are stated as being at every stage: "Approval gates at every stage - you stay in control of all decisions." Human corrections persist as behavioural rules. The five phases are Initialization, Ideation, Inception, Construction and Operation. There is no phase named release: deployment pipeline and deployment execution are stages inside Operation, alongside environment provisioning, observability setup, incident response, performance validation and feedback optimization. Code generation carries a wired-in reviewer agent with a two-iteration cap.
